features.name: Authentication
features.description: User authentication using Supabase with sign in, sign up, and session management

features.name: Subject Management
features.description: Create, read, update, and delete subjects with color coding

features.name: Note Upload & Processing
features.description: Upload PDF notes, parse content, chunk text, generate embeddings, and store in vector database

features.name: RAG Pipeline
features.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline for processing notes and generating embeddings

features.name: Exam Generation
features.description: Generate AI-powered exams from uploaded notes using vector similarity search and Gemini AI

features.name: Exam Taking
features.description: Take exams with real-time progress tracking, answer submission, and scoring

features.name: Exam List & Management
features.description: View all exams, filter by subject, and manage exam lifecycle

features.name: Vector Search
features.description: Semantic search using pgvector for finding relevant note chunks

features.name: PDF Parser
features.description: Parse PDF files, extract text content, and chunk into manageable pieces

features.name: Embeddings Generation
features.description: Generate text embeddings using Google Gemini text-embedding-004 model (768 dimensions)

features.name: File Storage
features.description: Upload and manage files in Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible storage)

features.name: Database Models
features.description: Prisma schema defining User, Subject, Note, NoteChunk, Exam, Question, Answer, and Performance models

features.name: UI Components
features.description: Reusable UI components including BentoCard, SubjectBadge, FileUpload, LoadingSpinner, EmptyState

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard showing overview of subjects, notes, and exams with statistics
